question: What would become of Reinhard if Subaru taught him the saying about “Liking the color of heroes”?
answer: He’d respond “I think it would be wonderful to make that many women happy, but I’m not that skilled. Even if I did fall in love, I’m sure it would only be with one person. But I think it’s better to not have someone be that important to you. I’d like to build something like that inside myself, and not waver. I don’t ever want to feel like that again, after all.”
